paragraphs.source_en: As Nobuyasu murmured to himself, footsteps sounded far down the corridor. Was someone bringing the evening meal, or had the envoy from Hamamatsu finally resolved to meet him? The footsteps seemed to belong to three people. Nobuyasu hurriedly closed the front of his robe. Now that his resolve was firm, he should meet his father’s envoys, say everything that must be said, and then calmly commit seppuku. That would be the greatest respect he could show his own life.
